installCommand: ORIG=$PWD; D=apps/web; [ -f "$D/package.json" ] || D=web; [ -f "$D/package.json" ] || D=.; cd "$D" && npm ci --include=dev
buildCommand: ORIG=$PWD; D=apps/web; [ -f "$D/package.json" ] || D=web; [ -f "$D/package.json" ] || D=.; cd "$D" && npm run build && cd "$ORIG" && if [ "$D" != "." ]; then cp -R "$D/dist" ./dist; fi
